Google has its own text watermark (which Anthropic’s is based on) it uses on the output of its Gemini models . OpenAI has yet to introduce a text watermark but it plans to do so . title: Legal AI Startup Harvey Hits $15.6 Billion Value With $550 Million Round
summary: Legal tech startup Harvey is now valued at $15.6 billion after raising $550 million in a new funding round aimed at powering efforts to build its own AI models.
